name: Bigdata.com
description: Bigdata.com is an AI-powered financial research platform that helps investment professionals search and analyze company information, financial documents, news, and other data.

events.d: Find companies by name, ticker, website or identifier, filtered by country, sector or type.
Search news, filings, transcripts, research and your files with text and filters.
Get a document's download link and, optionally, its full annotated content by ID.
